articles.summary: FORT WAYNE, Ind., Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Steel Dynamics, Inc. (NASDAQ/GS: STLD) today announced that the company’s board of directors authorized an additional share repurchase program of $3.0 billion of the company’s common stock. The authorization is effective immediately and is additive to the previous $1.5 billion program, which had $216 million remaining authorized […]
articles.title: Steel Dynamics Announces Additional $3.0 Billion Share Repurchase Authorization and Fourth Quarter 2026 Cash Dividend
